content: Hi! How can I help you today? Are you looking to share some event memories, or maybe organize your highlight video and photos?
Yes, I'd like to share the photos and the highlight video from our event with the team. I also want to make it easy for others to add any photos I may have missed.

That sounds wonderful! Let's create a shared album called "Event Highlights - June 2024". You can upload your photos and video there. Once it's ready, simply share the album link, everyone can click to browse the moments and download originals they want to keep.
Perfect. Should I set the album to allow others to upload, or just view?

Great question! For collaboration, I suggest enabling upload access just for your team, so they can add their own shots if they have any. For privacy, keep the link view-only for anyone outside the team.
I've uploaded my files and set the permissions. How can I label the best moments?

On most devices, just tap the photo or video and select 'Add Caption' or 'Favorite', for example, on iOS tap the info icon, then type a quick caption like 'Team toast' or 'Award ceremony'. Highlighted favorites will be easy for everyone to spot when they browse the album.
Done! Should I encourage people to download the full-resolution files?

Absolutely! Let your team know they can click any photo or tap 'Download All' for the originals, especially if they want to print or save a personal copy. On Windows or Mac, right-click and choose 'Download', or use the album export option.
Great. Do you think I should remind them to only upload photos with everyone's consent?
That's thoughtful! Gently remind everyone to only upload photos they're comfortable sharing, and to check with others if anyone's unsure. It helps everyone feel respected and included.
Thanks! I'm about to send out the link. Anything else I should include in my message?

You might add a quick note: 'Click the album link to browse, download your favorites, or upload any missing shots!' If you want, mention that captions and highlights are there to help everyone find special moments easily.
Will do. I'll send it out now!
Perfect! If anyone needs help downloading or organizing their files, whether on iOS, Android, or desktop, let me know. Enjoy reliving those great memories!
